'''Vatrachos Island''' is an island east of [[Varlamore]]. It requires 46 [[Sailing]] to moor on, as well as completion of the quest [[Children of the Sun]].

It contains [[Fishing spot (cage, harpoon)|fishing spots]] to catch [[raw lobster]], [[raw tuna]], and [[raw swordfish]], [[Vatrachos Island#Mining|mining spots]] and a [[rusty chest]]. It also contains multiple buildable utilities. [[Thigo]] can be found here, mining peacefully.

Once the rowboat is built, the player may travel to and from the island using a rowboat on the coast east of the [[Stonecutter Outpost]].

Using various edible fruits on the [[Raccoon (Vatrachos Island)|raccoon]] to the north side of the island will reward the player with one of the [[Medallion fragment|medallion fragments]] used to create the [[medallion of the deep]].

==Building the amenities==
Players will need the following items to build all of the [[Island amenity|amenities]]:

{{Checklist|
*1 [[hammer]]  '''(required for all facilities)'''
*1 [[saw]]  '''(required for all facilities)'''
*10 [[swamp paste]]
*8 [[camphor plank]]s
*4 [[iron bar]]s
*1 [[ball of wool]]
*2 [[oak plank]]s
*1 [[tinderbox]]
*1 [[coal]]
*4 [[limestone brick]]s
*1 [[bucket]]
}}

If a player brings the camphor and oak planks in a [[plank sack]], they will be able to build all utilities using 16 inventory slots or 12 inventory spots with a [[flamtaer bag]] (up to 2 less if using the [[Imcando hammer]] and/or [[Amy's saw]]).

==Trivia==
* The scenery object "[[A singular circle]]" has an examine text which reads "First, you draw a circle." This is a reference to the intro song for the game ''Kirby's Adventure''.
* The name of the island could be a reference to the greek word for frog, ''βάτραχος'' (pronounced va-tra-chos).
